docs.title: rtmix Overview
docs.text: rtmix implements Dual-Tail Process-Data Mixture IRT (DT-MixIRT) for modern digital assessments where examinees may exhibit either left-tail rapid guessing or right-tail AI-assisted copying, while honest slow careful examinees must remain strictly protected against false forensic accusations.

docs.title: Model Summary
docs.text:
For examinee $i$ and item $j$, DT-MixIRT models the trivariate observation $(Y_{ij}, \log T_{ij}, H_{ij})$ as a three-regime mixture:

  • Regime 0 (Genuine Solution Behavior, weight $1 - \pi_i^{\mathrm{RG}} - \pi_i^{\mathrm{AI}}$): 3PL accuracy $P_{0,ij} = c_j + (1 - c_j)\sigma(a_j(\theta_i - b_j))$, log-normal response time $\log T_{ij} \sim \mathcal{N}(\beta_j - \tau_i, \sigma_{T,j}^2)$, and baseline action/edit entropy $H_{ij} \sim \mathcal{N}(\gamma_j + \nu_i, \sigma_{H,j}^2)$.
  • Regime 1 (Left-Tail Rapid Guessing, weight $\pi_i^{\mathrm{RG}}$): Chance-level accuracy $c_j$, compressed response time $\mathcal{N}(\mu_{T,\mathrm{RG}}, \sigma_{T,\mathrm{RG}}^2)$, and minimal action entropy $\mathcal{N}(\mu_{H,\mathrm{RG}}, \sigma_{H,\mathrm{RG}}^2)$.
  • Regime 2 (Right-Tail AI-Assisted Copying, weight $\pi_i^{\mathrm{AI}}$): Elevated accuracy floor $p_{\mathrm{AI}}$, positive prompting-pause shift $\mathcal{N}(\beta_j - \tau_i + \Delta_T^{\mathrm{AI}}, \sigma_{T,\mathrm{AI}}^2)$, and collapsed edit entropy $\mathcal{N}(\mu_{H,\mathrm{AI}}, \sigma_{H,\mathrm{AI}}^2)$.

docs.title: Tutorial: Auditing Dual-Tail Digital Exam Process Data
1. Load or Prepare Trivariate Matrices
docs.text:
rtmix accepts three aligned 2D arrays of shape (N, J): - Y: binary correctness (0/1, NaN permitted for missing responses) - log_rt: natural logarithm of item response times (seconds) - entropy: keystroke or action-stream edit entropy per item response

from rtmix import load_benchmark_dataset, fit_dtmix_irt, audit_dual_tail_forensics

data = load_benchmark_dataset()
res = fit_dtmix_irt(
    data["Y"],
    data["log_rt"],
    data["entropy"],
    guessing=0.25,
    device="auto",
    compute_ci=True,
)

docs.title: 2. Inspect Examinee Flags, Confidence Intervals, and Item Posteriors
docs.text:
audit = audit_dual_tail_forensics(data["Y"], data["log_rt"], data["entropy"], res, alpha=0.01, min_pi=0.08)
print("Flagged AI-assisted:", audit.flagged_ai.sum())
print("Flagged Rapid Guessing:", audit.flagged_rg.sum())
print("Posterior simplex max error:", abs(res.posteriors.sum(axis=-1) - 1.0).max())

docs.title: 3. Compare Against Classical Baselines
docs.text:
from rtmix import fit_classical_irt, fit_vdl_speed_accuracy, fit_wise_nt_baseline, evaluate_ability_recovery

irt = fit_classical_irt(data["Y"])
vdl = fit_vdl_speed_accuracy(data["Y"], data["log_rt"])
nt10 = fit_wise_nt_baseline(data["Y"], data["log_rt"])

print("DT-MixIRT ability recovery:", evaluate_ability_recovery(data["theta_true"], res.theta))
print("Classical 3PL recovery:", evaluate_ability_recovery(data["theta_true"], irt.theta))
